prompt: A single RimWorld creature sprite in a painterly, hand-painted vanilla RimWorld style, realistic, with matte brushwork and soft painted shading, on a transparent background. The tentacle bundle is outlined with the same thin dark painted edge, outer tentacles clearly defined and inner strands shaded in a darker value, so globe and curtain read as one clear silhouette. The body has a smooth, featureless surface with no head, eyes, mouth or limbs. The creature hovers upright and at rest in still air, the globe and tentacle curtain keeping a consistent size, proportions and palette. Drawn at 2x2 tile scale, readable at small size.
